act.name: Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2016
act.source_authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India
act.description: Central law governing Aadhaar enrolment, authentication, subsidy delivery and identity-information security safeguards.

sections.title: Proof of Aadhaar number necessary for receipt of certain subsidies, benefits and services, etc.
sections.text: Section 7 governs Aadhaar proof or authentication for specified subsidies, benefits and services and the alternative means required pending assignment.
sections.plain_language_summary: For specified state-funded benefits, Aadhaar proof or authentication may be required, but a person not yet assigned a number must be offered alternate and viable identification means while applying for enrolment.
